results.title: The ideal counting function
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: Let $K$ be a number field with ring of integers $\mathcal O_K$. For $n\ge0$ let $a_K(n)$ be the number of ideals $I\subseteq\mathcal O_K$ of absolute norm $N(I)=|\mathcal O_K/I|=n$. This number is finite, and the Dedekind zeta function is the Dirichlet series absolutely convergent for $\mathrm{Re}\,s>1$.

results.title: The splitting law in $\mathbb Q(\sqrt d)$
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $K$ be a number field of degree $2$ and $d$ an integer that is not a square, such that $\mathcal O_K$ contains an element $\alpha$ with $\alpha^2=d$; for instance $K=\mathbb Q(\sqrt d)$ and $\alpha=\sqrt d$. Let $p$ be an odd prime with $p\nmid d$. Then the local sign $\varepsilon_p=a_K(p)-1$ is the Legendre symbol: so $a_K(p)=1+(d/p)$ and $a_K(p^k)=\sum_{j=0}^k(d/p)^j$ for every $k\ge0$.

results.title: The factorization of $\zeta_K$
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $K$ be a number field of degree $2$, with $\varepsilon_p=a_K(p)-1$, let $q\ge1$, and let $\chi$ be a Dirichlet character modulo $q$ with $\varepsilon_p=\chi(p)$ for every prime $p\nmid2q$.
